sourceNote: Persian text; English from public domain translations.

couplets.persian: اَلْیا اَیُّهَا السّاقی اَدِرْ کاسَةً وَ ناوِلْها
couplets.english: O cup-bearer, pass round the cup and hand it to me.

couplets.persian: که عشق آسان نمود اوّل ولی افتاد مشکلها
couplets.english: Love seemed easy at first, but then came hardships.
In the name of God the Compassionate the Merciful.

couplets.persian: صبا به لطف بگو آن غزال رعنا را
couplets.english: O morning breeze, tell that graceful gazelle with kindness.

couplets.persian: اگر آن ترک شیرازی به دست آرد دل ما را
couplets.english: If that Turk of Shiraz would take my heart in hand.

couplets.persian: به خال هندویش بخشم سمرقند و بخارا را
couplets.english: For her Indian mole I would give Samarkand and Bukhara.
